subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this stale maintainer prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into the current sub-agent guidance surfaces, or paused because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The branch is protected and the remaining choice is model-facing prompt policy across existing Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, and nested-spawn semantics, which automation should not decide for maintainers.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate
options.body: Resolve the conflict and fold useful examples into the current availability- and depth-aware prompt/tool-description guidance so there is one policy source.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, update runtime limits, config schema/help, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Pause As Covered
options.body: Keep this PR open for explicit maintainer direction or close it manually if current main guidance is enough.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict and fold useful examples into the current availability- and depth-aware prompt/tool-description guidance so there is one policy source.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged nested sub-agent orchestration work is the strongest current-main contract affected by the PR's blanket nested-spawn wording.
